messages.author: 46b63db5e5ff7d37
messages.subject: How to hide comment in the R code?
parts:
Dear lists,
I'm using an external R script when making HTML5 slides with knitr,
sometimes I want to hide the comments in R scripts, what should I do?

Thank you very much : )

Regards,
Weicheng

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] How to hide comment in the R code?
parts:
You probably need options(keep.comment = FALSE) which is for the
formatR package to remove R comments.

Regards,
Yihui
